description: Antigravity support tasks that unblock Claude Code / DPF implementation (not primary C++ author)

items.title: [ClaudeCode][DPF] Windows CMake configure + build log bundle
items.criteria: On Windows after git pull: run DiskLordz-Audio/build-windows.ps1 (CMake root DiskLordz-Audio/); build ChordEngine_VST3; save logs to disklordz/antigravity/outbox-artifacts/claude-code/build-log-latest.txt; publish-handoff to claude-code

items.title: [ClaudeCode][DPF] MusicTheory pytest harness from JSON fixtures
items.criteria: If docs/drafts/chord-engine/data/chord-spelling-v0.json exists, generate tests/drafts/dpf_music_theory_test.py (pytest) + run pytest -q; save junit or log to outbox-artifacts/claude-code/pytest-music-theory.log

items.title: [ClaudeCode][DPF] C++ stub outlines from data JSON (drafts only)
items.criteria: Read chord-spelling / progression seed JSON under docs/drafts/chord-engine/data/; write docs/drafts/dpf/MusicTheory_stubs.hpp.md with function signatures + field mapping for Claude Code to paste into DPF-MIDI — do not edit Source/ or Products/

items.title: [ClaudeCode][DPF] MIDI fixture regeneration + manifest
items.criteria: Refresh docs/drafts/test-fixtures/midi/ per WO-PREP-005 spec if missing; update manifest.json; zip folder to outbox-artifacts/claude-code/midi-fixtures.zip

items.title: [ClaudeCode][DPF] CMakeLists drafts for DPF-Core / DPF-MIDI skeleton
items.criteria: docs/drafts/dpf/cmake/CMakeLists.DPF-Core.draft.txt and CMakeLists.DPF-MIDI.draft.txt matching DPF_TECHNICAL_ARCHITECTURE layout; no commit to root CMake until Claude Code merges
